nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Admin API route for managing scheduled actions: GET lists pending/all scheduled actions, POST creates new ones, PATCH updates status (cancel, mark executed, etc.).

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: GET handler returning a paginated list of scheduled actions with optional status/agency filters.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: POST handler that schedules a new action by delegating to the scheduler service.

nodes.name: PATCH
nodes.summary: PATCH handler for updating a scheduled action's status (cancel, mark executed, retry) with audit logging.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Admin API endpoint that runs an Apify TikTok keyword search and returns scraped video metadata.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: POST handler that authenticates the admin caller and runs an Apify-driven TikTok search scrape, returning the resulting videos.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Admin API endpoint that enqueues a TikTok scrape job using Apify, optionally building keywords from configured frameworks.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: POST handler creating a TikTok scrape job, hooking into the jobs runner and Apify scraper service.

nodes.name: buildKeywordsFromFrameworks
nodes.summary: Builds a deduplicated keyword/hashtag set from configured viral frameworks, capped at maxKeywords.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Admin API endpoint that runs script-intelligence analysis on a script via the viral-prediction engine; supports POST analyze and GET status/history.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: POST handler invoking the script-intelligence engine to score a script and persist the analysis result.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: GET handler returning recent script-intelligence analyses with filters and pagination.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Admin API endpoint exposing readiness and health of the script-intelligence subsystem; POST allows toggling diagnostic flags.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: GET handler aggregating script-intelligence module status (API keys, recent runs, error counts) for the admin dashboard.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: POST handler for toggling script-intelligence flags and recording admin diagnostic actions.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Large admin facade for the script-intelligence engine — dispatches actions like analyze, generate, optimize, store/query memory, evolution metrics, zeitgeist, singularity metrics, winning patterns, and template naming.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: POST entry that dispatches to the appropriate script-intelligence action handler based on the action field.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: GET entry for read-only script-intelligence actions (stats, evolution, zeitgeist, patterns).

nodes.name: handleAnalyzeScript
nodes.summary: Handles a script analysis action by calling the script-intelligence engine and shaping the response.

nodes.name: handleGenerateScript
nodes.summary: Generates a new viral script via the engine using prompt context (platform, niche, goals).

nodes.name: generateTrendzoMarketingScript
nodes.summary: Produces a Trendzo-branded marketing script using templated context blocks tailored to platform and tone.

nodes.name: handleOptimizeScript
nodes.summary: Runs the engine's optimization routine over an existing script and returns suggested edits.

nodes.name: handleStoreMemory
nodes.summary: Persists a memory entry (insight, pattern, observation) into the script-intelligence memory store.

nodes.name: handleQueryMemory
nodes.summary: Queries the script-intelligence memory store with filters and returns matched entries.

nodes.name: handleGetMemoryStats
nodes.summary: Returns memory store statistics: counts by type, recency distribution, and storage health.

nodes.name: handleGetPatternEvolution
nodes.summary: Computes how viral patterns have evolved over time using historical memory entries.

nodes.name: handleGetCulturalZeitgeist
nodes.summary: Returns current cultural-zeitgeist indicators derived from recent script observations.

nodes.name: handleGetSingularityMetrics
nodes.summary: Computes 'singularity' metrics — convergence indicators across viral patterns and trends.

nodes.name: handleGetWinningPatterns
nodes.summary: Returns the top-performing script patterns filtered by platform and niche.

nodes.name: handleGenerateTemplateName
nodes.summary: Generates a catchy, branded template name from input viral indicators and pattern scores.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Admin security dashboard API aggregating threats, blocked IPs, system health, trends, vulnerabilities, and recommendations into a single security overview payload.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Aggregates the full security-dashboard payload (threats, blocked IPs, system health, score, recommendations).

nodes.name: getActiveThreats
nodes.summary: Returns currently active threats from the security monitor.

nodes.name: getBlockedIPs
nodes.summary: Returns blocked IPs along with reasons and timestamps.

nodes.name: getSystemHealth
nodes.summary: Probes core subsystems and returns an aggregated system-health snapshot for the security dashboard.

nodes.name: getSecurityTrends
nodes.summary: Calculates time-bucketed trends of security events within the requested range.

nodes.name: getTopVulnerabilities
nodes.summary: Returns the most frequent/severe vulnerabilities observed by the security monitor.

nodes.name: getAPISecurityStatus
nodes.summary: Reports per-API security posture (auth coverage, rate-limit hits, suspicious activity counts).

nodes.name: calculateSecurityScore
nodes.summary: Computes an overall 0-100 security score from collected metrics and system health.

nodes.name: generateSecurityRecommendations
nodes.summary: Generates actionable security recommendations based on metrics and current system health.

nodes.name: getVulnerabilitySeverity
nodes.summary: Maps a vulnerability type string to a severity label.

nodes.name: getVulnerabilityDescription
nodes.summary: Returns a human-readable description for a given vulnerability type.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Admin API for browsing and emitting security events; GET lists filtered events, POST records a new manual event.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Returns a filtered, paginated list of security events drawn from the security monitor.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: Records a new manual security event via the security monitor (e.g., admin-triggered investigations).

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Admin endpoint that seeds the database with demo template records for development and demo environments.

nodes.name: buildDemoTemplates
nodes.summary: Builds an array of synthetic template records used to populate demo data.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: GET handler that inserts demo templates into Supabase and returns the count inserted.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Admin endpoint that seeds the database with demo video records (with derived TikTok ids) for development data.

nodes.name: buildDemoVideos
nodes.summary: Constructs an array of demo video records covering varied creators, niches and metric profiles.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: GET handler that upserts demo video records into Supabase and returns the seeded count.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Admin self-test endpoint that probes environment, Supabase connectivity, and key dependencies, returning a readiness summary.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Runs a synchronous self-test: probes env vars, Supabase, and external services and returns a pass/fail report.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Admin endpoint returning the count of divergences between shadow and production predictions.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Admin endpoint returning aggregated success-tracking metrics (story counts, conversion rates, performance KPIs).

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Aggregates success-tracking metrics from Supabase and returns a KPI bundle for the admin dashboard.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Admin endpoint to PATCH-update a success-tracking story record (status, metrics, notes).

nodes.name: PATCH
nodes.summary: Updates fields on a success-tracking story by id in Supabase.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Admin success-tracking stories CRUD-lite endpoint: GET lists stories with filters, POST creates a new story record.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Returns a list of success-tracking stories filtered by status, customer or date range.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: Creates a new success-tracking story record with validation.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Super-admin dashboard data endpoint aggregating system-wide metrics, user counts and module summaries.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Aggregates super-admin dashboard data from multiple Supabase tables into a single response payload.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Super-admin endpoint reporting per-module health, uptime and error counts across the platform.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Queries module status records and derives an aggregated module health view for super-admin.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Super-admin endpoint returning recent prediction validation results (predicted vs actual VPS comparisons).

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Returns recent prediction-validation rows with computed accuracy summaries.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Super-admin quick-predict endpoint: extracts metadata from a TikTok URL, runs the orchestrator/master viral algorithm pipeline, and returns a fast viral prediction with breakdown.

nodes.name: extractRealFollowerCount
nodes.summary: Attempts to derive a creator's real follower count from URL/creator metadata.

nodes.name: extractVideoDuration
nodes.summary: Estimates the video duration for the given TikTok URL via downloader / probing.

nodes.name: extractHashtagsFromContent
nodes.summary: Parses hashtags out of a TikTok caption/URL for use in feature extraction.

nodes.name: extractVideoData
nodes.summary: Assembles a combined VideoData object (creator, duration, hashtags, captions) from various sources for downstream prediction.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: POST handler that runs the full quick-predict pipeline: extract metadata, run orchestrator + master viral algorithm, persist prediction, return breakdown.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: GET handler returning recent quick-predict results for super-admin browsing.

nodes.name: generateAnalysisBreakdown
nodes.summary: Produces a per-component prediction breakdown formatted for UI consumption.

nodes.name: generateFallbackPrediction
nodes.summary: Returns a deterministic fallback prediction object when the full pipeline fails.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Super-admin endpoint aggregating platform-wide system metrics — counts, throughput, error rates, latency percentiles.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Aggregates platform-wide metrics from Supabase tables and returns a structured metrics payload.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Super-admin endpoint that discovers new template candidates by analyzing viral patterns and saves derived templates.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: Runs the template-discovery pipeline: analyze patterns, build candidate templates, persist, update generators.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Returns recently discovered templates and discovery-run statistics.

nodes.name: analyzeViralPatterns
nodes.summary: Analyzes recent viral patterns to identify common signals that can become templates.

nodes.name: saveTemplatestoDatabase
nodes.summary: Persists newly discovered templates into the templates table.

nodes.name: updateTemplateGenerators
nodes.summary: Updates downstream template-generator records to reference newly created templates.

nodes.name: generateFallbackTemplates
nodes.summary: Returns a deterministic set of fallback template candidates when discovery analysis fails.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Admin endpoint to revoke a telemetry key by id.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Admin telemetry-keys endpoint: POST issues a new telemetry key, GET lists existing keys.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Admin endpoint listing recent plugin telemetry events.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Returns the most recent plugin telemetry events with admin-auth gating.

nodes.name: route.ts
nodes.summary: Admin template-analysis endpoint: POST runs backend template analysis on inputs, GET returns recent analyses.

nodes.name: POST
nodes.summary: Delegates template analysis to the backend service and persists the analysis result.

nodes.name: GET
nodes.summary: Returns recent template-analysis results with optional filters.
